A '''class''' of warship was utilized by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The ''[[Ambria's Fury]]'' and the ''[[Fatality]]'' were two [[Starship/Legends|starships]] of this class, though they both crashed during in the middle of the war in [[Engagement over Belsavis|battles]] [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|above]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] and [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] respectively.
